passages.sermon:
David wrote this song.
This song is called a Miktam.
David is the author.
A Miktam is a type of psalm or poem.

passages.text: Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this prayer.
David calls it a Miktam.
David speaks to God.
David says, “Preserve me, O God.”
David asks God to keep him safe.
David says, “I take refuge in You.”
David trusts God for protection.
passages.original: מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שָֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי־ חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: I said to the LORD, “You are my Lord; apart from You I have no good thing.”
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David calls the LORD his Master.
David says, “You are my Lord.”
David says, “I have no good thing apart from You.”
David means that every good thing comes from the LORD.
David means that without the LORD, he has nothing good.
passages.original: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־ עָלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
passages.sermon:
David speaks in this psalm.
David is the author.
David addresses God.
David describes the saints.
The saints live in the land.
The saints are holy people.
The saints are excellent.
David delights in the saints.
David finds all his delight in them.
passages.original: לִ֭קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝אַדִּירֵ֗י כָּל־ חֶפְצִי־ בָֽם׃

passages.text: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
passages.sermon: People who chase other gods will have many sorrows.\r\nI will not pour out their offerings of blood.\r\nI will not speak their names with my lips.
passages.original: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֪ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל־ אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל־ אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־ שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל־ שְׂפָתָֽי׃

passages.text: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is my chosen portion.
The LORD is my cup.
The LORD gives me what I need.
The LORD makes my lot secure.
The LORD keeps my future safe.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה מְנָת־ חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃

passages.text: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
passages.sermon:
God gives me my land.
My land is in a good place.
My inheritance is beautiful.
I am pleased with what God has given me.
passages.original: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־ לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־ נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃

passages.text: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gives me counsel.
I will bless the LORD.
He guides me.
Even at night, my conscience instructs me.
God’s guidance continues in the night.
My inner thoughts teach me when it is dark.
passages.original: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף־ לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃

passages.text: I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is always before me.
I have set Him in front of me at all times.
He stands at my right hand.
Because He is with me, I will not be shaken.
passages.original: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־ אֶמּֽוֹט׃

passages.text: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will dwell securely.
passages.sermon:
David prays to God.
David trusts God.
My heart is glad.
My tongue rejoices.
My body will live in safety.
passages.original: לָכֵ֤ן׀ שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף־ בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח׃

passages.text: For You will not abandon my soul to Sheol, nor will You let Your Holy One see decay.
passages.sermon:
God is faithful.
God will not abandon my soul to Sheol.
God will not let His Holy One see decay.
God protects those who are devoted to Him.
God keeps His faithful ones from destruction.
passages.original: כִּ֤י׀ לֹא־ תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא־ תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת׃

passages.text: You have made known to me the path of life; You will fill me with joy in Your presence, with eternal pleasures at Your right hand.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
God shows David the path of life.
God fills David with joy when David is with Him.
God gives David eternal pleasures at His right hand.
passages.original: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־ פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃
